records.headline: Kestrel Digital launches digital skilling academy for 3,000 Pune youth
records.text: Kestrel Digital Ltd today announced the Kestrel Digital Skilling Academy, a CSR programme that will train 3,000 young people from low-income households in Pune in digital and workplace skills over the next two years. The company said it has committed Rs 12 crore to the programme from its CSR budget. Training will run from community centres in Hadapsar and Pimpri. The company said it will work with implementation partners to deliver classroom sessions and placement support. Details of the partner selection process will be shared later this year.
records.funding: Rs 12 crore committed from the CSR budget (stated).
records.partner_evidence: The company 'will work with implementation partners' but has not opened a call; selection details are to be shared later.
records.summary: Kestrel Digital launched a two-year digital skilling academy for 3,000 low-income youth in Pune, funded with Rs 12 crore of CSR money, delivered from centres in Hadapsar and Pimpri with implementation partners.
records.why: Exact match for the NGO's programme model and home geography; the company has stated it will use implementation partners, so early contact could position the NGO before a formal call opens (interpretation).
records.next_action: Call this week: contact Kestrel's CSR team to register interest before the partner selection process is announced.
records.outreach_angle: We already run placement-linked digital skilling for first-generation job seekers in Pune and could deliver at your Hadapsar and Pimpri centres.

records.headline: Saffron Motors starts school-to-work programme for Class 10 dropouts in Pimpri-Chinchwad
records.text: Saffron Motors Ltd has started a school-to-work programme for students who left school after Class 10 in Pimpri-Chinchwad and Pune. The CSR programme will offer six-month automotive technician courses followed by apprenticeships at the company's Chakan plant. A company spokesperson said the first batch of 400 learners will begin in January. The company has allocated Rs 5 crore for the first year, according to the spokesperson.
